lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var σ x wf mem => exact absurd mem (Option.not_mem_none _)
  case abs σ t₁ τ L h ih =>
    left
    exact Value.abs (LC.abs L (Ty.Wf.of_env_ty (h (fresh L) (fresh_notMem L)).wf.1).lc
      fun x hx => (h x hx).wf.2.1)
  case tabs σ t₁ τ L h ih =>
    left
    exact Value.tabs (LC.tabs L (Ty.Wf.of_env_sub (h (fresh L) (fresh_notMem L)).wf.1).lc
      fun X hx => (h X hx).wf.2.1)
  case app t₁ σ τ t₂ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    cases ih_l rfl with
    | inr red => obtain ⟨t₁', h⟩ := red; exact ⟨t₁'.app t₂, .appₗ r.wf.2.1 h⟩
    | inl val => cases ih_r rfl with
      | inr red => obtain ⟨t₂', h⟩ := red; exact ⟨t₁.app t₂', .appᵣ val h⟩
      | inl val₂ =>
        obtain ⟨_, u, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val
        exact ⟨u ^ᵗᵗ t₂, .abs val.lc val₂⟩
  case tapp t₁ σ τ σ' der sub ih =>
    right
    cases ih rfl with
    | inl val =>
        obtain ⟨_, u, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
        exact ⟨u ^ᵗᵞ σ', .tabs val.lc (Sub.wf _ _ _ sub).2.1.lc⟩
    | inr red => obtain ⟨t₁', h⟩ := red; exact ⟨t₁'.tapp σ', .tapp (Sub.wf _ _ _ sub).2.1.lc h⟩
  case sub t τ τ' der sub ih => exact ih rfl
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L der h ih ih₂ =>
    right
    have B : t₂.body := ⟨L, fun x hx => (h x hx).wf.2.1⟩
    cases ih rfl with
    | inl val => exact ⟨t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁, .let_body val B⟩
    | inr red => obtain ⟨t₁', h⟩ := red; exact ⟨t₁'.let' t₂, .let_bind h B⟩
  case inl t₁ σ τ der wf ih => exact (ih rfl).imp Value.inl fun ⟨t₁', h⟩ => ⟨.inl t₁', .inl h⟩
  case inr t₁ σ τ der wf ih => exact (ih rfl).imp Value.inr fun ⟨t₁', h⟩ => ⟨.inr t₁', .inr h⟩
  case case t₁ σ τ t₂ δ t₃ L der h₂ h₃ ih ih₂ ih₃ =>
    right
    have B₂ : t₂.body := ⟨L, fun x hx => (h₂ x hx).wf.2.1⟩
    have B₃ : t₃.body := ⟨L, fun x hx => (h₃ x hx).wf.2.1⟩
    cases ih rfl with
    | inl val =>
        obtain ⟨u, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val
        · cases val with | inl v => exact ⟨t₂ ^ᵗᵗ u, .case_inl v B₂ B₃⟩
        · cases val with | inr v => exact ⟨t₃ ^ᵗᵗ u, .case_inr v B₂ B₃⟩
    | inr red => obtain ⟨t₁', h⟩ := red; exact ⟨t₁'.case t₂ t₃, .case h B₂ B₃⟩
